title: Move Outlook messages to a chosen folder with AI
h1: move an outlook email into the right folder
description: File completed Outlook emails where you will find them later. A bot finds the message and folder, previews the move and reports the result.
keyword: outlook move email to folder with ai
answer: **get completed claims out of your inbox and into the folder you'll search later.** a bot finds the outlook message and destination, then moves it within the same mailbox. ask for a subject-and-folder preview before it moves anything. this is a write, so the sending setting won't pause it for review. you get a result for each move.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: a known message in a known folder.
what:
**find both ends before moving anything.** the bot looks up the exact email and destination folder. tell it to stop rather than choose a similar folder name. this stays within one mailbox; it won't transfer mail to a colleague.

if a move fails, have the bot find the message again before retrying. small batches make the result easier to inspect and avoid piling moves on at once.
uses: **close out a warranty claim.** file the completed message under its existing project folder.
**clear a handled confirmation.** move it once its event details are in your plan.
**repair a filing mistake.** return one email to the folder it belongs in.
**keep supplier mail together.** move the chosen thread's individual messages into the same mailbox folder.

routine.message:
every friday at 11:55, read messages in my outlook folder warranties / ready to file for oakmarsh warranties. use that folder as the input, not previous chat messages.

find the existing warranties / completed folder. show each selected subject and destination here, then ask me before moving anything. move only the messages i confirm and report each result. never create folders, delete mail or guess a message. if nothing is ready, say so briefly.
routine.needs: outlook read and write; existing ready-to-file and completed folders in the chosen mailbox
routine.output:
oakmarsh warranties
message: replacement hinge confirmation
from: warranties / ready to file
to: warranties / completed

message and destination found. ready for your decision.

steps: **choose the mailbox.** allow outlook read and write for this filing bot.
**find the destination first.** ask it to list folders and show the one you mean.
**put review in the job.** read one subject and destination together before allowing a move.
**inspect the result.** open the destination after the first move. pause the routine if the filing rule becomes unclear.
watch: **don't retry a stale lookup.** if the move fails, find the email again before one more attempt.
**large batches need patience.** move a few at a time so you can track what happened.

faq.q: can it make a new folder if it's missing?
faq.a: **not with this action.** it moves mail into an existing folder. create the destination in outlook first.

faq.q: will this move mail into a colleague's mailbox?
faq.a: **no, it stays in one mailbox.** the source message and destination folder belong to the same user.

steps: pick one email in the chosen mailbox
ask the bot to find its destination folder
review the subject and folder together
confirm the move, then open the destination

mistakes.mistake: assuming ask every time covers filing
mistakes.fix: that setting covers sends. put "ask me before moving anything" in the filing request.

mistakes.mistake: retrying without finding the email again
mistakes.fix: look it up afresh after a failure. open the destination before repeating a move.

tip.text: start with one message. if its destination looks wrong, you have one correction instead of a missing inbox.
